In the conversation between ChaeSong-hwa and LiHua regarding the karaoke activity, LiHua expresses interest in adding some classic songs to the playlist. Specifically, LiHua suggests two songs:

1. "I Will Survive" - LiHua believes this to be a great choice because it is an upbeat and popular song.
2. "Sweet Caroline" - He also suggests this classic tune, noting that it is always a crowd-pleaser.

Additionally, LiHua mentions that they should definitely include "Sweet Caroline" and "Dancing Queen." These songs are intended to make the karaoke session enjoyable and engaging for all participants.
